name: update_task
title: Update a task
description: Record progress on a task: labels, a note, title, description, repository, relations, theme, priority, complexity, acceptance items and/or a stage move. All or nothing: a refused label or a blocked gate records nothing. A move that needs a human approval records the rest and waits for it.

complexity.description: Complexity points: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 or 13 (split larger cards); null removes them.

complexity_reason.description: Reason for the complexity (1–300 characters); needs numeric points.

stage_id.description: Id of the stage to move the task to (the pipeline is in your instructions).

add_labels.description: Label ids to add. A label of a group replaces the other labels of its group.

note.description: Timeline note: findings, decisions, what changed; with labels, their comment.

reply_to.description: Comment event id: reply to it.

description.description: New description (markdown). It replaces the whole description: read the current one with get_task first, all of it if it says it is cut.

repo.description: Project repository the task works in; null clears it. Refused while a session runs.

add_relations.description: Relations of this card to other cards to add. part_of: this card is a one-level subtask of the other (same project); prerequisite: this card can only be done after the other (order cards with this, not with a "Dependencies" text); related: the cards belong together, nothing more; duplicate_of: this card duplicates the other and is closed pointing at it (only a card that has not started: waiting in a queue stage, no session; otherwise whoever may cancel it marks it: an admin, the owner, or the project manager when the project settings allow it). Point at the original, never at another duplicate. A refused relation (a prerequisite loop, itself, another project) refuses the whole call.

task_key.description: The other card, in this project.

remove_relations.description: Relations of this card to other cards to remove; removals apply before additions.

kind.description: The relation as this card sees it, also a reverse one.

theme_key.description: The open theme this card belongs to; null removes it. Not for subtasks and themes.

priority.description: The card priority; null clears it. An AI member sets it only when the project's priority setting allows it.

despite_prerequisites.description: Move into the work stage despite an open prerequisite. Honored only for a person, or the project manager when team.prerequisiteOverride allows it; otherwise the start waits.

acceptance.description: Changes of the acceptance items (the conditions of "done") in order, all or nothing with the rest of the call. add (text); edit (item_id, text; an open item); remove (item_id); done (item_id, evidence) and not_needed (item_id, reason) and move (item_id, task_key: the item goes to that card as an open one): the assignee or a person marks them; reopen (item_id, note): the assignee or the owner of the current step sets an item open again; confirm (item_id): the owner of the current step, never the one who marked it nor the assignee. Item ids are in get_task.

item_id.description: The acc_… id from get_task; not for add.

evidence.description: done: how it is met (the commit, the test, the file, the observed behavior).

reason.description: not_needed: why it does not apply.

task_key.description: move: the open card that takes the item over.
